control_flow: Forever: call followLine; if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else drive straight forward.

branches.outcome: the line tracker sees black: it curves left
the line tracker doesn't see black: it drives straight forward

input_dimensions.dimension: what the line tracker sees while following

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left while the line tracker sees black and drives straight forward while it doesn't
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the black line, facing along it, in bright light
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then no black, again and again
scenarios.title: Follows the line
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end

uncertainties: The program curves left on black and drives straight otherwise, so on a line it may leave the line instead of following it.
You didn't say where the line ends or what the robot should do when it loses the line.

outcomes.words: the condition doesn't hold: the else part runs

deferredInputs.reason: Your program drives straight when it doesn't see black, so a start beside the line just drives past it: that isn't a situation of its own. And you didn't say where the line ends or what to do there.
deferredInputs.dimension: what the line tracker sees while following

worlds.name: A line that bends to a goal

tests.name: Follows the line to Goal 1
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line at A and the line bends to the left, when the program runs, then it follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at its end without bumping into anything.

equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: A, on the line's black core, facing along the line
equivalence_partitions.dimension: what the line tracker sees while following

expected_results: It follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at the line's end.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1.
During the whole run, it never bumps into anything.

assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.

tests.reason: Following the line to its end is what you said.
